q.stem: For days d = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, the recorded numbers of cases are respectively 100, 350, 250, 600, 723, 702, 750, 790. Day 1 is October 19. Fit an ordinary least-squares line predicting cases from d. What is the first whole date on which its prediction is at least 1,000?

assets.verification_note: Original source image decrypted, hash checked, and visually inspected. Corrected choice C from October 29 to October 28 and specified the first whole date at or above the threshold.
assets.verification_source: EST II - Math Level 1 - December 2020.pdf page 13

choices.text: October 20
October 23
October 28
October 31
November 1

k.explanation: The fitted slope is Σ(d−4.5)(N−533.125)/Σ(d−4.5)² = 98.9166667 and the intercept is 88. The prediction reaches 1,000 at d=(1000−88)/98.9166667≈9.2199. It is 978.25 on day 9 and 1077.1667 on day 10, so the first whole day is day 10, October 28.

q.stem: Let a and b be positive real numbers with a≠b. For real t, what curve is represented by x=a sin t and y=b cos t?

assets.verification_note: Original source image decrypted, hash checked, and visually inspected. Added positive parameters to exclude the original circle and degenerate exceptions.
assets.verification_source: EST II - Math Level 1 - May 2021.pdf page 5

choices.text: Circle
Ellipse
Straight line
Parabola
Hyperbola

k.explanation: Dividing gives x/a=sin t and y/b=cos t. Squaring and adding yields x²/a²+y²/b²=1. Positive a and b give an ellipse with nonzero semiaxes; a≠b makes it noncircular.

q.stem: An ellipse has equation \(x^2/a^2+y^2/b^2=1\), where a>b>0. Its area is πab=35π and a+b=12. What is its equation?

assets.verification_note: Original source image decrypted, hash checked, and visually inspected. Added a>b>0 to make the horizontal major-axis orientation explicit instead of relying on apparent diagram proportions.
assets.verification_source: EST II - Math Level 1 - October 2021.pdf page 14

k.explanation: The numbers a and b have sum 12 and product 35, so they are the roots of t²−12t+35=(t−5)(t−7)=0. Since a>b, a=7 and b=5. Substituting their squares gives x²/49+y²/25=1.
